summary: Celcuity Inc. furnished an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing Phase 3 VIKTORIA-1 clinical trial results for gedatolisib in HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer. The filing reports statistically significant improvements in progression-free survival and objective response rate versus alpelisib plus fulvestrant. This is a routine clinical data disclosure, not a special situation; no M&A, activist, restructuring, or capital markets event is involved. The registrant is issuing the update on its own behalf.
